name: hare_apparent_the_first_hare_makes_no_rabbit
notes: M3 mapper. Printed: 'When this creature enters, create a number of 1/1 white Rabbit creature tokens equal to the number of other creatures you control named Hare Apparent.' Seat 0 controls no other Hare Apparent (a Rabbit-typed creature named otherwise does not count): the entering Hare makes no Rabbit.
